headline: Huang back as Nvidia CEO, S&P best day since April 2025, futures lower, Brent below $90
stance: Monday's rally came from one company's CEO decision, not from rates. Treasuries did not move and a Fed official kept back-to-back hikes open.

news.head: Nvidia -4% pre-market after Huang reinstated as CEO
news.body: Board reversed course Monday (~4:49am ET). Record single-stock options volume Monday (~6:24pm ET).

news.head: Sanofi to buy Insmed for $41bn
news.body: Biggest biotech deal in nearly three years. Offsets a patent expiry on a key Sanofi drug (~4:14am ET).

news.head: Zoom beats on Q3, raises 2026 outlook
news.body: Revenue and earnings both above estimates, reported after the close Monday (~4:20pm ET).

news.head: SharkNinja to join the S&P 500
news.body: Replaces AES in the index (~6:18pm ET Monday).

implications: 10y unchanged at 4.92% Monday while the S&P had its best day since April 2025. Treasuries did not sell off on the rally.
Fed's Williams would not rule out back-to-back hikes (~6:08pm ET Monday). Wednesday's PCE is the last inflation print before the FOMC.

watch.head: Industrial production, 9:15
watch.body: October factory, mining and utility output.

watch.head: USD/JPY 159.00 option expiry, 10:00 cut
watch.body: Strike under 30 pips from spot (~1:28am ET). 160.00 is where Japan intervention risk returns.

watch.head: PCE, GDP and durable goods, Nov 25, 8:30
watch.body: Jobless claims move up a day. US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Williams kept back-to-back rate hikes on the table (~6:08pm ET Monday). A December hike is broadly expected.
Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite US escort (~12:05am ET). Brent below $90, near three-month lows (~2:05am ET).
USD/JPY pushing toward 160.00 (~2:07am ET). Dollar index rose Monday despite the rally in stocks.
sections.positioning: Speculators long 2y Treasury futures at the 94th percentile of three years, new this week.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite had their best sessions since April 2025 Monday. S&P seven-day losing streak ended.
Consumer staples were among the S&P 500's biggest decliners Monday as chips rallied.
US stock futures lower (~4:23am ET). European stocks opened mixed: DAX -0.3%, CAC 40 +0.3% (~3:23am ET).
sections.positioning: VIX still above VIX3M at the close Monday despite a 9-point VIX drop. The curve stays inverted.

single_name.note: New to the screen today, score 3. One insider-buy rule fired; filing Nov 20. Trades above its 200-day line.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HY OAS 376bp Friday, +56bp since Nov 12. IG +9bp to 98bp over the same six sessions.
Listed BDCs at 0.89x NAV median Monday vs 0.94x on Nov 13.
sections.positioning: HY ETFs did not join the rally Monday: HYG/LQD ratio unchanged on the day.
